name: TCode
description: TCode is a contamination-free, complexity-controllable benchmark dataset for evaluating large language models on syntax-preserving code translation. It controls complexity along multiple dimensions such as syntactic nesting and expression intricacy, enabling fine-grained assessment of model capabilities and introducing a static feature sensitivity evaluation framework.
reputation: A recent contamination-free code translation benchmark introduced for fine-grained evaluation, but it is not yet widely established as a community standard.
notes: Introduces correlation-driven analysis based on static program features; highlights capability boundaries of LLMs in code translation.
